chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 456: Profound Bone’s Secret Plot – A Masterclass in Xianxia Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: The Profound Bone Saint hands Han Li the tools to catch a spirit ginseng, but his true goal is murder and body-snatching. A tense chapter of veiled conspiracy.
og_title: Scheming on the Wind-Swept Seas – Chapter 456
og_description: A golden net, a stolen formation, and a whispered plot to seize Han Li’s body. The alliance cracks before it has even begun.
twitter_description: Profound Bone hands Han Li the weapons of his own doom in this chillingly calm betrayal chapter. No combat, all calculation.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary, sentient spirit plant capable of fleeing through solid earth; it can only be captured by pure gold.
A trace of residual celestial energy left behind by a high-grade spiritual creature, visible only to extremely powerful spiritual senses, typically Nascent Soul level.
A secret mental cultivation technique that strengthens the practitioner's divine sense, allowing enhanced perception and control over multiple magical tools.
An ancient earth-element formation that binds the surrounding stone and soil, turning them as hard as iron to trap targets.
A legendary and extremely rare wood whose refined state creates a powerful Yang-element magical treasure that is devastating against demonic and ghostly entities.
The signature demonic cultivation technique of Extreme Yin Island; the Profound Bone Saint left a hidden flaw in its deepest layers to ensure he could destroy the practitioner.
